objective: One common GUARD congestion-control configuration: mean paired reduction >10% versus the original fixed Homa runtime for BOTH overall P95 and overall P99, separately in each of six workload/load cases.
final_rule: Freeze source, executable, libraries, configuration and analysis before generating final inputs; retain all attempts, failures, negative results, and all input flows. If final results guide another change they become development data; reserve new independent inputs.
percentiles: Linear interpolation on all completed flow FCTs whose start time is after fixed 25% warmup. Compute P95 and P99 separately for each repetition, then mean paired percentage reductions against identical-input Homa. No size bins for acceptance.
interpretation: The target is an empirical acceptance criterion, not an assumed conclusion.
